info.name: univ-v2-timetable
info.description:
Schedule date-wise redesign — full integration collection.

**Docs:** `docs/AFFECTED_APIS_SCHEDULE_DATEWISE_REDESIGN.md` · `docs/SCHEDULE_DATEWISE_API_URLS.md`

## ID legend
| Use | Field | Do not use |
|-----|-------|------------|
| Week grid / mapping | `timeTableCellId` | `timeTableMappingId` |
| Day / attendance / lesson / roster | `timeTableCellDateWiseId` | mapping id + date |
| Lecture window teacher | `userId` | `employeeId` on `lecture_window` |

## Integration order
1. `① /timeTable` — structure + courseMapping
2. `② /timeTableCreate` — cells + publish (creates date-wise rows)
3. `③ /employee` — schedule → capture `timeTableCellDateWiseId`
4. `④ /attendance` — mark with date-wise id
5. `⑤ /lesson` — `getRoutineByTeacher` (published + week date-wise) then map with date-wise id
5b. `⑤b /lecture + /options` — lecture window `userId`; options accept `userId` or `employeeId`
6. `⑥ /student` — roster + week timetable

## Smoke chain
```
GET  /timeTable/
POST /timeTableCreate/
POST /timeTableCreate/mapping
PATCH /timeTableCreate/publish?timeTableRoutineId=
GET  /employee/schedule?userId=
POST /attendance/
POST /lesson/mapping
GET  /student/classSectionStudents?timeTableCellDateWiseId=
```

Set `baseurl` + `token` before calling. Run backfill migrations on existing DB before testing GETs.

item.name: ① /timeTable — structure + courseMapping
item.description:
Step ① — structure template + course mapping. No cell / date-wise IDs.

`sessionId` lives only on course mapping, not on structure root.

item.name: structure (/timeTable)
item.description:
| # | Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|--------|------|---------|
| 1 | POST | `/timeTable` | Create structure + periods |
| 1 | POST | `/timeTable/structure/clone` | Copy existing structure + periods |
| 1 | POST | `/timeTable/period` | Add one period |
| 1 | PATCH | `/timeTable` | Update period rows (array) |
| 1 | DELETE | `/timeTable` | Delete one period |
| 2 | POST | `/timeTable/courseMapping` | Map course + session + dates |
| 2 | PATCH | `/timeTable/structure` | Update mapping by mapper id |
| 2 | DELETE | `/timeTable/courseMapping` | Delete mapping if no routine |
| 3 | GET | `/timeTable` | List structures + `courseMappings[]` |
| 3 | GET | `/timeTable/all_name` | Structures filtered by course/session |
| 3 | GET | `/timeTable/single` | One structure by id |
| 3 | GET | `/timeTable/structureMappings` | Flat print/table rows |
| 4 | DELETE | `/timeTable/structure` | Delete structure if unmapped |

request.description:
**POST /timeTable**

Creates structure template only. Do **not** send `courseId`, `sessionId`, or dates.

```json
{
  "name": "Morning Schedule",
  "maximumPeriod": 6,
  "periodLength": 45,
  "periodGap": 5,
  "startingTime": "09:00 AM",
  "type": "Automatic",
  "weekOff": ["Sunday"],
  "isCourse": true
}
```

**POST /timeTable/structure/clone**

Copies an existing structure template and all its period rows.

Stores `sourceTimeTableNameId` on the new structure (self FK).

Does **not** copy course mappings, routines, or grid cells.

```json
{
  "timeTableNameId": 10,
  "name": "Morning Schedule Copy"
}
```

`name` is optional. Default: `Copy of {source name}`.
**POST /timeTable/period** — add one period row to an existing structure.
**PATCH /timeTable** — body is an array of period updates.

**PATCH /timeTableCreate/create** — batch update structure period rows.

Send a **non-empty array** (same shape as `PATCH /timeTable`):

```json
[
  {
    "timeTableCreationId": 112,
    "startTime": "10:00 AM",
    "endTime": "10:55 AM",
    "periodName": "Period2",
    "isBreak": true
  }
]
```

**DELETE /timeTable?timeTableCreationId=**

Deletes one period row. Blocked if used in published/active routine.

**POST /timeTable/courseMapping**

Binds structure → course + session + date window.
Returns `timetableStructureCourseMapperId` for routine create.

**Unique:** `(timeTableNameId, courseId, sessionId)`

**PATCH /timeTable/structure**

Updates a course mapping by `timetableStructureCourseMapperId`.
Can change structure / course / session / dates.

**DELETE /timeTable/courseMapping?timetableStructureCourseMapperId=**

Deletes structure–course mapping when **no routine** references it.

**400** if any routine exists under this mapper.

**GET /timeTable**

Lists root structures with cloned copies nested in `variants[]`.

- `sourceTimeTableNameId: null` → root structure
- `sourceTimeTableNameId` set → nested under its source in `variants[]` (supports copy-of-copy)

Each structure includes `courseMappings[]`, period rows (`timeTableName[]`), and `variants[]`.

Unmapped → `courseMappings: []`. Empty copies → `variants: []`.

query.description: Optional — filter structures mapped to this course

request.description:
**GET /timeTable/all_name**

Restored FE endpoint. Returns structures (with periods + matching courseMappings[]).

Optional query: courseId, sessionId.

Example: /timeTable/all_name?courseId=45

**GET /timeTable/structureMappings**

Flat structure + course-mapping rows for printing a table (no periods).

### Query (all optional)
| Name | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `courseId` | Filter by course |
| `sessionId` | Filter by session |
| `timeTableNameId` | Filter by structure |
| `timetableStructureCourseMapperId` | Filter by mapping PK |

### Response `data[]`
`timetableStructureCourseMapperId`, `timeTableNameId`, `structureName`, `maximumPeriod`, `periodLength`, `periodGap`, `startingTime`, `weekOff`, `courseId`, `courseName`, `courseCode`, `sessionId`, `sessionName`, `startingDate`, `endingDate`

**DELETE /timeTable/structure?timeTableNameId=**

Deletes structure + periods only when **no course mapping** exists.

**400** if any row exists in `time_table_structure_course` for this structure.

request.description:
**GET /timeTableCreate/** — optional `courseId`, `sessionId`.

### Top-level fields
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `draftRoutineCount` | Total draft routines for course/session filter |
| `publishedRoutineCount` | Total published routines for course/session filter |
| `years[]` | Section/term tree |

### Per `classSectionTermId` (inside `years → classSections → semesters[]`)

| `publishedRoutineCount` | Published routines for that section-term |

item.name: get routine by course and section

request.description:
**GET /timeTableCreate/create**

Bootstrap UI for routine create.

### Query
| Name | Required | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| `courseId` | yes | Course id |
| `classSectionTermId` | for `normal` | Required unless `timeTableType=elective` |
| `timeTableType` | no | `normal` (default behavior) or `elective` |

### Elective (`timeTableType=elective`)
Returns the **same shape as** `GET /getRoutine`, elective-only schedule cells:

```json
{
  "classSectionTermId": null,
  "section": null,
  "term": null,
  "year": null,
  "courseId": 39,
  "sessionId": null,
  "structures": [
    {
      "timeTableNameId": 10,
      "name": "Morning Schedule",
      "weekOff": ["Sunday"],
      "timetableStructureCourseMapperId": 1,
      "courseId": 39,
      "sessionId": 6,
      "startingDate": "2026-01-01",
      "endingDate": "2026-12-31",
      "routines": [
        {
          "timeTableRoutineId": 55,
          "timetableStructureCourseMapperId": 1,
          "isPublished": false,
          "startDate": "2026-01-01",
          "endDate": "2026-06-30",
          "year": null,
          "periods": [
            {
              "timeTableCreationId": 112,
              "name": "Period1",
              "startTime": "09:00 AM",
              "endTime": "09:45 AM",
              "days": [
                {
                  "name": "Monday",
                  "scheduleItems": [
                    {
                      "type": "elective",
                      "teachers": [],
                      "subject": { "electiveSubjectId": 1, "name": "Elective A" },
                      "room": { "classRoomSectionId": 2, "name": "R1" }
                    }
                  ]
                }
              ]
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "classSection": null
}
```

Mapped structures with no elective routine still appear with `routines: []` and an empty period grid.

### Normal
Returns the legacy bootstrap array for section create UI (requires `classSectionTermId`).

**GET /timeTableCreate/getRoutine?classSectionTermId=**

Weekly grid grouped **structure → routines[]**.

If no routine exists for the section, still returns mapped structures for that section's **courseId + sessionId** with `routines: []` and empty period grid.

```json
{
  "classSectionTermId": 101,
  "courseId": 45,
  "sessionId": 6,
  "structures": [
    {
      "timeTableNameId": 10,
      "name": "Morning Schedule",
      "timetableStructureCourseMapperId": 1,
      "courseName": "B.Tech CSE",
      "sessionName": "2025-26",
      "routines": [],
      "periods": []
    }
  ]
}
```

query.description: Optional — filter normal schedule cells by subjectId

request.description:
**GET /timeTableCreate/getRoutineByTeacher** — `userId`, `courseId`, `sessionId` required.

Optional `subjectId` filters normal cells. Response teachers include **`timeTableCellId`**.

**POST /timeTableCreate/**

Requires `timetableStructureCourseMapperId`. Section must match mapping course+session. Dates inside mapping window.

Do **not** send `timeTableNameId`.

**PATCH /timeTableCreate/create** — update draft routine (object body).

Blocked if published.

```json
{
  "timeTableRoutineId": 55,
  "startingDate": "2026-01-01",
  "endingDate": "2026-06-30",
  "classSectionTermId": 101,
  "timetableStructureCourseMapperId": 1
}
```

For **period batch update**, send an **array** to the same URL (see `update structure periods (batch)` in structure folder).

**POST /timeTableCreate/clone**

Clones routine + cells into a new date range (same mapper). Optional `previousDate` closes source routine.

**PATCH /timeTableCreate/publish?timeTableRoutineId=**

Sets `isPublish: true` and **creates `time_table_cell_date_wise` + teacher rows** for each working day in the routine window.

After publish, call `GET /employee/schedule` to obtain **`timeTableCellDateWiseId`** per period.

**DELETE /timeTableCreate?timeTableRoutineId=**

Deletes a draft routine and all week cells + date-wise rows.

### Rules
- Routine must **not** be published (`isPublish: false`)
- Routine must **not** have started (`startingDate` is in the future)

### Response `data`
`timeTableRoutineId`, `deletedScheduleCount`, `message`

**POST /timeTableCreate/mapping** — single cell.

Returns **`timeTableCellId`** (week template PK). Co-teachers: add via `PATCH /mapping/update-create`.

Cell still needs `timeTableNameId` (structure period FK). Use **`userId`** (not employeeId).
**PATCH /timeTableCreate/mapping/update-create** — body is a non-empty array; first row needs **`timeTableCellId`**.

item.name: ③ /employee — schedule → timeTableCellDateWiseId
item.description:
Step ③ — day-view schedule. Each period returns **`timeTableCellDateWiseId`** + **`timeTableCellId`**.

Use these ids for attendance, lesson mapping, and student roster.

request.description:
**GET /employee/schedule** — `userId` required. Optional: `date`, `sessionId`, `groupPeriods` (`consecutive` | `sessional`).

Captures first `timeTableCellDateWiseId` into collection variable.

exec: const list = res.result || res.data || res.schedules || (Array.isArray(res) ? res : []);

request.description: **GET /employee/pastSchedule** — same query as schedule; dates before cutoff.
**GET /employee/sectionDates** — date-wise period list for class-section + subject + teacher.

exec: const list = res.result || res.data || res.schedules || (Array.isArray(res) ? res : []);

item.name: ④ /attendance — timeTableCellDateWiseId
item.description: Step ④ — mark / list / copy attendance using **`timeTableCellDateWiseId`** (not `timeTableMappingId`).

item.name: ⑤ /lesson — mapping uses timeTableCellDateWiseId
item.description:
Step ⑤ — lesson plan APIs. Period key = **`timeTableCellDateWiseId`**.

| # | Method | Path | Notes |
|---|--------|------|-------|
| 1 | GET | `/lesson/getRoutineByTeacher` | Published week grid + **one week** date-wise cells; `teacherType` Primary/Secondary |
| 1 | GET | `/lesson/mapped` | Progress table: lesson/topic/subtopic + class date (`timeTableCellDateWiseId`) |
| 1 | GET | `/lesson/employee` | Subjects + lessons by `userId` |
| 2 | POST | `/lesson` | Create lesson (`lectureWindowId` required) |
| 2 | GET | `/lesson` | List lessons |
| 2 | GET | `/lesson/simple` | Simple list |
| 2 | GET | `/lesson/single` | One lesson |
| 2 | POST | `/lesson/link` | Link lesson → lecture window |
| 3 | POST | `/lesson/topic` | Add topic |
| 4 | POST | `/lesson/mapping` | Map topic → `timeTableCellDateWiseId` |
| 4 | POST | `/lesson/mapping/copy` | Copy mapping to other date-wise cells |
| 4 | GET | `/lesson/mapping` | List mappings |
| 4 | PATCH | `/lesson` | Set `completeDate` on mapping |
| 4 | PATCH | `/lesson/mapping/:lessonMappingId` | Update mapping fields |
| 4 | DELETE | `/lesson/mapping/:lessonMappingId` | Delete mapping |

Flow: `getRoutineByTeacher` → capture `dateWise.timeTableCellDateWiseId` → `POST /lesson/mapping`.

query.description: Optional — any date in the week (Mon–Sun). Default today.

request.description:
**GET /lesson/getRoutineByTeacher**

Required: `userId`, `courseId`, `sessionId`, `subjectId`.
Optional: `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) — returns that calendar week (Mon–Sun).

- **Published routines only**
- Full week grid (day-wise)
- One week of dated schedule items for that teacher
- `teacherType`: Primary | Secondary
- Response `week` includes `previousWeekDate` / `nextWeekDate` for navigation (pass as next `date`)
- `scheduleItems[].lessonPlan`: one object `{ lessonMappingId, lessonId, lessonName, topicId, topicName, subTopics, subTopicName, lectureWindowId, lectureWindowName, note, lectureUrl, file, status, completeDate }` per `timeTableCellDateWiseId`, or `null`

Use `scheduleItems[].timeTableCellDateWiseId` for mapping.

**GET /lesson/mapped**

Required: `userId`, `subjectId`. Optional: `courseId`, `sessionId`, `lessonId`, `status`.

Returns `{ lessonPlan: [...] }` — same object shape as `scheduleItems[].lessonPlan` on getRoutineByTeacher:
`lessonMappingId`, `timeTableCellDateWiseId`, `lessonId`, `lessonName`, `topicId`, `topicName`, `subTopics`, `subTopicName`, `lectureWindowId`, `lectureWindowName`, `note`, `lectureUrl`, `file`, `status`, `completeDate`, `attendanceTaken`.

If attendance has been taken for a dated class, `attendanceTaken: true` and `status` is forced to `complete`.
**GET /lesson/simple** — lightweight lesson list (includes lecture window fields when linked).

item.name: ⑤b /lecture + /options — userId on lecture window
item.description:
Lecture windows store teacher as **`userId`** (not employeeId).

| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| POST | `/lecture` | body optional `userId` |
| GET | `/lecture` | filter optional `userId` |
| GET | `/lecture/:lectureWindowId` | detail + lessons |
| PATCH | `/lecture/:lectureWindowId` | dates/name |
| DELETE | `/lecture/:lectureWindowId` | only if no lessons |
| GET | `/options/lectureWindows` | **`userId` OR `employeeId`** (at least one) + `subjectId` + `date` |

When `employeeId` is sent on options, API resolves employee → `userId` then filters windows.

request.description:
**POST /lecture** — optional `userId` (teacher). Tenant + academicYear from session.

```json
{
  "subjectId": {{timetable_subjectId}},
  "userId": {{timetable_userId}},
  "sessionId": {{timetable_sessionId}},
  "startDate": "2026-07-01",
  "endDate": "2026-07-15",
  "name": "Unit 1 — Introduction"
}
```

**GET /options/lectureWindows**

| Key | Required | Notes |
|-----|----------|-------|
| `userId` | Yes* | Teacher userId |
| `employeeId` | Yes* | Alt — resolves to userId |
| `subjectId` | Yes | |
| `date` | Yes | YYYY-MM-DD; windows with startDate <= date <= endDate |
| `sessionId` | No | |

*At least one of `userId` or `employeeId`.

**200:** `{ selected: { employee, subject }, options: [{ lectureWindowId, name }] }`
**GET /options/lectureWindows** with `employeeId` — server looks up employee.userId then filters lecture windows the same way.
